boundaries: Only extracted original helpers and explicit ordinary callers; no whole-database theorem
Native debug/release oracle is finite supporting evidence, not a formal Rust library proof
Warm record/owned candidates regenerate; poisoned caches are not claimed as cache hits
Generic arithmetic callers need no assistance; constant boundary callers use --infer-goals
Generic callers pass ordinary verification without --infer-goals; blanket optional BV expansion can exhaust rlimit and is not counted.
Debug-on requires the actual debug guard; debug-off omits it. Native release wrapping outside the checked domain is not modeled as a safety proof.
Only canonical Range<u64> is admitted by the proxy exception; no general external proxy or mutable/stateful abstraction is introduced.
